lines: Open item 251 has its cause, and it is not the drawing. Two machines drew film frames 3000 to 3298 again with every picture kept: eight PNG hashes are the same on both, and frame 3298 drawn alone equals 3298 reached through the run. The coding is what differed: x264 with a rate cap on two threads gave three files from three codings of the same 150 pictures, on each machine; one thread gave the same file three times, two threads without the cap twice. The mend is written (`agent/p6-root-guards` `2b8b18dd`: a capped coding of a film chunk has one thread, held by `tests/encode-repeat.test.ts`) and merges with the next chain. The master chunk has no cap; its line was coded here three times at 3840 x 2160 on 30 frames and three times at 960 x 540 on 150 frames, the same file each time. The one encode of a whole master has a cap and every thread, so made twice its bytes will differ; the kit asks sameness of the mix and of pictures, not of the film file. Not proven: that the two chunks first sent came from equal pictures, since those were removed after coding.

The publish. The 40 first pictures were drawn (01:25:49 to 01:45:35 UTC) and are commit `7f68d26e`, on origin main since 02:04 UTC after its checks in a clean tree: tsc exit 0, vitest 61 files passed and 1 skipped with 834 tests passed and 9 skipped, build exit 0 (engine `04d60c2dcdbccaa1`), and with the built folder in place "poster: pass · 40 stills and the table agree with the framing". The fresh security reviewer started at 01:54 UTC; the app is published when it answers without a block. Picture 1 is the four seasons as that build opens.

Picture 2, fall's miniature after its builder's second list (`agent/p6-fall-scene` `c2370a04`): approved left, the build without its air in the middle, with its air right. Bark ridges in the trunk's geometry, a wider cap and taller stack, rougher shingles, a lighter door with grain, a deeper pane, smaller darker litter, and the trunk's far flank darkened. Its numbers: miniature 0.804 against main's 0.789, the line still fails at 0.6996 on the base, G15 at high 1,791,317 of 1,800,000 triangles, six stills of the other seasons equal to main's. Below the bar, in its own words and by my eye: the trunk is not yet black with a cool rim, the fence is posts and rails where the approved has uneven pickets, the pane has one cross, the litter by the left pumpkin is too orange; and the cottage is smaller in the ball than the approved one. It merges in the next chain; a third list follows.

The glass's limb at 3840 (`agent/p6-summer-glass` `08c71e07`, one line): the dots on the outline are gone in frames 1875 to 1878 (largest step between frames from 63 to 88 levels down to 17 to 19), every pixel that moves by more than 2 levels lies within 2.2 px of the outline in all eight stills, M3 summer 0.882. Two pale lines just inside the limb still shimmer slightly; they are next on its list. It merges alone in the chain after the next.

The table's petals at 3840 (frames 676 to 690, drawn by the inertia's builder at the draft tier): both faults seen earlier are still there and are not the inertia's. Petals slide 0.4 to 1.2 px a frame toward the ball's moving foot, and single petals turn over between two frames (682 to 683, 684 to 685). Cause: `src/seasons/spring/slab.ts` 107 to 120 moves the petals away from where the foot is at each sample, with a hard cutoff at line 117. The mend was ordered at 02:03 UTC: clear the petals from where the foot rests, no hard cutoff, the same look in the other seasons' table dressing; line at 02:45, limit 03:30 UTC.

The shutter builder's machine stopped answering at 01:44:54 UTC, with two renders at once and 47 MB free of 7.9 GB. Its work on the rows of beads (even sample times and an evenly filling place in the pixel for frames that travel more than 6 px) is written and tested there but not committed. It was told to stop the renders, commit and push before any render, and draw one at a time; if the machine has not answered by 02:10 UTC a second builder starts from its description. The mend's time moves from 03:30 to 04:00 UTC. No frame after the mend has been seen.

Spring's base, its builder's line (not pushed, so STATED): working tree at "pass M3 spring-rest: 0.7805", the flank's green share 0.29 where main has 0.05 and the approved 0.27, median 21 where main has 27 and the approved 18; push by 02:50 UTC. Summer's tree, its builder's line: the crown rebuilt as one broad dark dome with gold points on the outlines and a slimmer trunk, push by about 02:20 UTC.
The pushes were refused for about a minute at 01:47 UTC and worked again at 01:48 with nothing changed here.

16 agents are at work at 02:04 UTC: summer (tree, miniature, air, glass, sand, stone), fall (base, air), spring (base), winter's glints, the change of season, the controls, the shutter, the table's petals, and the security reviewer.

Render counts since the last status. Drawn here: the last 18 of the 40 first pictures; no still, no film frame. On helper machines: 300 draft frames at 960x540 for item 251 (150 on each of two machines) and four single frames; 15 frames at 3840 at the draft tier for the petals; at 3840 final the shutter's builder drew frames 643 and 300 and part of 1990. No frame of the masters yet.
Sound: 7,420 of 10,000 credits, unchanged, no call planned.
